report:
Fresh final marker followup of meta.book.index_rows. Preserved previous input/output, started fresh and assessed the complete claim, ordinary table implementation, TODO implementation region, ordinary generated-page test and TODO test. Recaptured every prior additional dependency: anchors.js, fixture helpers, Markdown rendering, review status inventory, preprocessor invocation, escaping, canonical URLs and relative URLs. Compared all fragments by path/selector and both metadata sets. The only captured differences are one-line boundary shifts in two spec.rs line ranges: incidental leading context is added and trailing neighboring-function context removed. The complete relevant chapter URL/namespace and relative_url helpers remain present and unchanged. All other captures, claim, association metadata and tests are identical; none were removed. This reassessment accounts for actual captured changes rather than blindly refreshing a verdict.

The ordinary table implementation builds the Design Anchors index from canonical SpecIndex names. Each active name has a main data-anchor row and separate initially hidden data-anchor-text row. The main row shows its final component with namespace groups/page heading providing context, full identity in title, and a relative link to its own generated anchor page. Separate cells derive implementation and test status sets independently, including Missing where empty; runtime results are not used. The claim renderer supplies Markdown text safely within the HTML table. Disclosure buttons use aria-controls/aria-expanded and sit adjacent to name links. Captured anchors.js tracks expandedText separately from collapsed groups: toggling text affects its second row while main-row visibility depends only on enclosing groups. Its delegated handler responds to buttons, leaving name links to navigate normally. Source inspection supports these mechanisms but is not browser interaction evidence.

The ordinary generated_anchor_pages_join_namespaces_claims_implementations_tests_and_reviews test constructs three canonical anchors, including a rule namespace, nested child and sibling, with ordinary/TODO/N/A source entries and varied review outcomes. It invokes real preprocessing and asserts exact root and descendant row lists, three-anchor count, groups/status summaries, an aria-controls target, rendered strong text, generated namespace/leaf pages and unchanged canonical inventory size. Evidence/review/context assertions give additional page coverage but do not directly establish every final-component label/title, asymmetric status column, or DOM click result. Fixture helpers expose actual subprocess output and recursive chapter inspection.

The assertion-free TODO anchor_index_rows_show_rules_and_status remains both implementation and test evidence for those missing focused scenarios. Completing it requires generated DOM assertions for each label/full-name tooltip and separate status cell, disclosure open/close checks that preserve the main row, and name-link navigation without toggling. Existing rendered enumeration and source inspection do not discharge this browser/integration TODO. There are no N/A entries. Thus all requirements are supported by inspected mechanisms and ordinary assertions or remain explicitly deferred by the existing TODO, whose scope is unchanged.

No source edits, formatting, tests, browser sessions or workspace build were performed. Executed review start/read, capture comparisons and record only. The incidental capture-boundary shifts introduce no behavioral change or lost relevant dependency. No requested edits.
